notes.title: Transfer Expander from Desura to Steam
notes.content:
I understand that everyone who got the game in a Bundle from Desura is frustrated about their situation so here is my way to help you out and “transfer” the game over to Steam.

In case Desura ever gets back to me and wants keys to send to you, you will most likely get a 2nd free copy of the game. Sell it, offer it here in the forums, donate it on twitter… do whatever you want with it :)

The process is a bit complicated but i want to make sure that i don’t drown in fraud attempts.

——-

[b]UPDATE[/b]

Thanks to TJMcKimmey here is a new version:

[b]Step 1[/b]

Send an E-Mail to desuratosteam@allcivilizedplanets.com and add

your E-Mail address (yes, please do it)
a link to your Desura User in this format: [noparse]http://www.desura.com/members/YOUR_USER_NAME/games[/noparse]

[b]Step 2[/b]

I will send you a steam code to your Desura User via Direct Message.

——-

Please note that i have to do this process step by step on my own so it may take a day or two until everything goes through. If i find a flaw in the process i may also change it - let’s just see how it works out.

I hope this way we can all be happy and meet in the Expander High-score List real soon.
